soldier: The soldier has the head capsule brown with yellow, mandibles deep brown, labrum and antennae yellowish brown, pronotum, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head capsule short cylindrical, the sides slightly diverging backwards, the posterior margin broadly rounded; in profile the dorsal angle of the frons slightly raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched, the ventral margin of the postmentum straight. The frontal surface with a shallow V-shaped depression, the anterior arm of the Y-shaped suture visible, both ocelli and compound eyes discernible. Labrum trapezoidal, its tip upturned and rather curved, the basal prominence of the mandible projecting, the left mandible about half the length of the head capsule. Antennae with ten segments. The postmentum five times as long as its narrowest part, the widest region behind the anterior third, with a pale dot-like elevation in the middle of this region, the waist region in the posterior third. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head capsule, the anterior margin shallowly concave, the sides parallel, the posterior margin nearly straight, the median notches of both the anterior and posterior margins very shallow.
